from itertools import permutations

def find_all_interval_series(n):
    """Find a permutation of 0..n-1 where consecutive differences are a permutation of 1..n-1"""
    
    # Use backtracking search
    series = []
    used_vals = set()
    used_diffs = set()
    
    def backtrack():
        if len(series) == n:
            return True
        
        for val in range(n):
            if val in used_vals:
                continue
            
            if len(series) == 0:
                series.append(val)
                used_vals.add(val)
                if backtrack():
                    return True
                series.pop()
                used_vals.remove(val)
            else:
                diff = abs(series[-1] - val)
                if diff == 0 or diff in used_diffs:
                    continue
                series.append(val)
                used_vals.add(val)
                used_diffs.add(diff)
                if backtrack():
                    return True
                series.pop()
                used_vals.remove(val)
                used_diffs.remove(diff)
        
        return False
    
    if backtrack():
        return series
    return None
